name: Retinotopic Connectivity Matrix Computation
summary: Computes retinotopic structural connectivity matrix between visual areas

parameters.description:
Defines eccentricity intervals (degrees of visual angle).
Example: "0-2,2-4,4-6,4-8"
Use "all" to disable eccentricity binning.

Defines polar angle intervals (degrees).
Example: "0-90,90-180"
Use "all" to disable polar binning.

area_by_area
Compute connectivity between visual areas within each eccentricity/polar bin.
Produces one matrix per bin (or a single matrix if bins are set to "all").
bin_by_bin
Compute connectivity between eccentricity bins across two visual areas.
Produces a single ecc × ecc matrix.

First visual area used for connectivity analysis.
(Only used when mode = "bin_by_bin")

Second visual area used for connectivity analysis.
(Only used when mode = "bin_by_bin")

connectome: 
Fast method using MRtrix tck2connectome (endpoint voxel assignment).
pairwise: 
Slower but stricter method using explicit streamline filtering (tckedit).
(Only used when mode = "areas_by_areas")
true → enforce ordered endpoint matching (A→B and B→A computed separately, then merged; used when <area_matrix_method> =  pairwise)
matrix_elements: Defines whether the bin-by-bin matrix rows/columns represent eccentricity bins (eccentricity) or polar-angle bins (polar).(Only used when mode = "bin_by_bin")
